target: Bind a signed local embedded-audit proof's head_sha to the commit an auditor actually examined, not a later 'evidence head' successor, and require the canonical AGENTS.md 9.1 packet proof bundle to exist at the PR head and agree with the signed proof on audited commit and controlling verdict identity.
invariants: SCOPE: scripts/audit/local_audit_acceptance.py is the sole fail-closed acceptance engine for the signed-local-attestation route. This packet only widens what it verifies -- it must never weaken signature verification, allowed-signers trust, namespace binding, repository or PR identity, or the existing passing-verdict policy.

EVIDENCE: caught by an automated reviewer bot on PR #1235 (DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp): a signed proof named an AUDIT_EVIDENCE_HEAD commit (a4c9aef015..., which only added report files) as head_sha, instead of the commit an AGY audit actually examined (bbcd474a0f...). The diff-scope check (audited..PR-head touches only the proof dir) never inspected the evidence-head commit's own contents, so nothing verified it added ONLY report files and not something else.

NOT A NEW PRECEDENT REPAIR: the same evidence-head-as-head_sha pattern is already committed for PR #1224 (proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-1224/PROOF.json, head_sha=3fa5c8e97b998734205a2dbd42a282ff82625ce6, auditor examined 488e6b89773255ac08b915a2bc6ba6e489a33ce2). This packet does not retroactively repair or invalidate that proof's substantive audit -- see the separate PR #1224 proof-binding-refresh follow-up.

PACKET_ID MUST BE SCHEMA-DERIVED: the allowed second directory (proof/<PACKET_ID>/) must be derived from the trusted schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json report_path pattern -- never from a separate, independently-trusted field an attacker could point anywhere.

TWO PROOFS MUST AGREE, NOT MERELY COEXIST: requiring the canonical packet bundle to exist is not sufficient by itself -- its own PROOF.json must declare the same audited head_sha and the same status/auditor_tool/auditor_model as the signed PR proof, or a packet bundle for an unrelated audit could sit alongside a false signed proof.

SINGLE POLICY ENGINE: schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json remains the only authority on embedded_audit shape. The packet-proof's embedded_audit object is validated against the same schema+policy path as the signed PR proof's, not a second hand-written check.
NO RETROACTIVE HISTORY REWRITE: existing merged proofs (e.g. PR #1224) are not amended by this packet. Any consequence for them is a separate, explicitly-scoped follow-up.

R2 (round-2 review repair): existing-path checks that treated 'has a descendant blob under this string prefix' as equivalent to 'is this exact required file/directory' are structural bugs, not just style -- a file misnamed to collide with a required directory path, or a directory nested under a required file path, must not be treated as satisfying that requirement. report_path must resolve to an exact blob; review_bundle must resolve to an exact tree (git object type checked, not string-prefix matching) containing >=1 blob.

R2: the packet PROOF.json's own declared packet_id must equal the PACKET_ID this module derives from the signed report_path -- path placement under proof/<PACKET_ID>/ is not itself proof of identity; the bundle's own content must self-declare and agree.

R2: ATTESTED_AUDITED_SHA, not PROVEN_AUDITED_SHA -- the signed proof's head_sha is documented as an operator's claim about which commit was audited, never a cryptographic binding to an external auditor's actual execution. This module's real, enforceable guarantee is that no commit after the attested SHA can smuggle code past the gate; it cannot and does not verify the content AT the attested SHA was truly what an auditor examined. That harder problem (binding to auditor-signed evidence, not producer-signed) is explicitly out of scope here.

R2: scripts/audit/sign_local_audit_proof.sh must mirror the canonical-packet-bundle checks this module enforces, so a malformed/missing/disagreeing bundle is caught at signing time locally, not only after CI evaluates the pushed commit.

R3 (round-3 review repair): the commit allowlist itself is a contract-sensitive surface -- it must name every path the packet's own steps commit, including the PR-scoped signed proof (proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-<N>/**), not only the canonical packet bundle. An allowlist that omits a path its own steps require does not actually authorize the committed change set.

R3: signer preflight must run the packet embedded_audit object through the SAME canonical schema+policy validation the trusted acceptance engine runs (_validate_embedded_audit against the trusted schema, plus the passing-status policy check), not merely compare three identity fields -- a packet object that agrees on status/auditor_tool/auditor_model but fails schema/policy elsewhere (e.g. required:false, missing invocation) must not be signed as 'proof shape OK'.

R3: 'review_bundle has >=1 entry' must mean an actual blob, not any git object type ls-tree happens to print at that path -- a gitlink/submodule entry satisfies a bare name-only listing without providing any real in-repository audit evidence. Object type must be checked, not merely presence.

R4 (round-4 review repair): PACKET_ID must never be allowed to collide with the reserved 'pr_merge' top-level segment under proof/ -- that directory is the shared root every PR's signed proof lives under (proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-<N>/), not one packet's own directory. The schema's report_path pattern's [^/]+ wildcard has no way to encode that reservation, so this module must reject it explicitly; accepting it would widen the diff-scope allow-list to the entire shared namespace, letting a proof successor touch any other PR's signed attestation while still passing the proof-only-delta check.

R5 (round-5 review repair): 'is this path a real blob' must check the git MODE (100644/100755), not merely the object TYPE -- a symlink reports object type 'blob' too (its content is a target path string, not stored audit evidence), so a type-only check the R3 gitlink fix introduced would still accept a symlink-only review_bundle or report_path. Applied to both the report_path exact-file check and the review_bundle >=1-entry check.

R5: scripts/audit/sign_local_audit_proof.sh must call the ACTUAL _extract_packet_id from local_audit_acceptance.py, never a separately re-implemented derivation -- a parallel implementation is exactly what let the signer keep accepting PACKET_ID='pr_merge' after R4 taught the acceptance engine to reject it, guaranteeing a local-success/CI-failure gap identical in shape to the one R3's signer-parity fix was supposed to close for good.

R6 (round-6 review repair): the signer's preflight checks the WORKING TREE (Path.is_file/is_dir/rglob), but the trusted acceptance engine reads the packet bundle from COMMITTED git blobs at the final PR head -- these are not the same thing. Path.is_file()/is_dir() also FOLLOW symlinks, unlike the engine's git-mode-based checks. The signer must (a) explicitly reject symlinked report files and a symlinked review_bundle root via is_symlink(), not merely is_file()/is_dir(), and (b) require the packet bundle directory to have zero uncommitted git changes (git status --porcelain) before signing, since a bundle present only in the untracked/modified working tree will be absent or stale at the actual committed PR head CI evaluates.

R7 (round-7 review repair): R6's symlink rejection covered the report file and review_bundle root, but missed packet_proof_path (proof/<PACKET_ID>/PROOF.json) itself -- a TRACKED symlink there can be clean per git status (the symlink is committed) while is_file()/read_text() follow it to valid JSON elsewhere on disk, but CI reads the committed blob bytes, which for a symlink is the target PATH STRING, not JSON. Same is_symlink() rejection must apply to every packet-bundle path the signer reads, not just some of them. Also: docs/ops/embedded-audit.md's per-PR runbook flow must document the packet-bundle-commit-first ordering R6 now enforces, or operators following the documented flow hit an undocumented 'uncommitted changes' failure.

R8 (round-8 review repair, surfaced by the R7 independent audit's own adversarial pass rather than a live GitHub review comment): Path.is_symlink() only inspects the FINAL path component -- it says nothing about ANCESTOR directories. A symlinked packet_dir itself (proof/<PACKET_ID> pointing elsewhere) would make report_file.is_symlink(), review_bundle_dir.is_symlink(), and packet_proof_path.is_symlink() ALL return False (each only checks the leaf at the resolved location), silently bypassing every leaf-level symlink check R5-R7 added at once. The signer must guard packet_dir.is_symlink() once, up front, and skip every downstream packet_dir-based check on failure rather than re-deriving the same guard per leaf check.

commit.message: fix(audit): bind local-attestation head_sha to the actually-audited commit and require the canonical packet proof bundle to agree with it

pr.title: fix(audit): bind signed local-attestation head_sha to the actually-audited commit
pr.body: Closes a gap an automated reviewer caught on PR #1235: a signed local embedded-audit proof could name an evidence-head successor (which only adds report files) as head_sha instead of the commit an auditor actually examined, so the diff-scope check never inspected that successor's own contents. head_sha must now be the real audited commit; the diff-scope allow-list widens to include proof/<PACKET_ID>/ (derived fail-closed from the schema-validated report_path) alongside the existing proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-<N>/, so the AGENTS.md 9.1 canonical packet bundle can land in the same delta -- but the bundle must now actually exist at the PR head and its own PROOF.json must agree with the signed proof on audited SHA and controlling verdict identity.

steps.task: Repair scripts/audit/local_audit_acceptance.py: derive PACKET_ID fail-closed from the schema-validated report_path; widen the diff-scope allow-list to proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-<N>/ and proof/<PACKET_ID>/; require proof/<PACKET_ID>/PROOF.json, the report_path file, and a non-empty proof/<PACKET_ID>/review_bundle/ to exist at the enforced PR head; require the packet PROOF.json's head_sha and embedded_audit status/auditor_tool/auditor_model to agree with the signed PR proof.

Update tests/audit/test_local_audit_acceptance.py fixture to build a canonical packet bundle by default, and add regression coverage: evidence-head masquerading as audited SHA -> FAIL; canonical packet proof successor + PR proof successor -> PASS; missing packet PROOF.json -> FAIL; missing/empty review_bundle -> FAIL; missing packet report -> FAIL; post-audit non-proof path -> FAIL; wrong packet directory -> FAIL; packet/PR proof head_sha or verdict-identity mismatch -> FAIL; head mismatch -> FAIL.
Independent different-family/runtime L3 audit against the exact substantive head (code + tests only, no post-audit proof artifacts).

Canonical packet proof bundle (proof/TP-DMX-LOCAL-AUDIT-PROOF-BINDING-001/{PROOF.json,AUDITOR_REPORT.md,review_bundle/}) as a proof-only successor, then signed pr_merge PROOF.json with head_sha = the actual audited commit.
Fresh exact-head CI + PR Steward. Stop for operator merge decision -- do not merge.
